description_expanded: Golden Getaway —Luxury Coastal Home Near Beach Favorite Features: - Game Room - In-Home Elevator - Theatre Room About Golden Getaway: Experience the ultimate coastal getaway in the heart of Seagrove Beach, where laid-back luxury meets the natural beauty of Florida’s iconic 30A. This stunning four-story new construction home is designed for unforgettable group stays, featuring 12 spacious bedrooms, 12 full bathrooms, and 2 half baths—perfect for large families, retreats, or special gatherings. Just a five-minute walk from the sugar-white sands and emerald waters that define the area, you’ll enjoy effortless access to one of the Gulf Coast’s most serene and picturesque beaches. Known for its peaceful, upscale vibe and uncrowded shoreline, Seagrove offers a true escape with scenic dune landscapes, coastal lakes, and charming neighborhood streets ideal for biking and strolling. Inside, the home blends modern coastal elegance with comfort and functionality across four expansive levels, offering multiple living spaces for relaxing and entertaining. Whether you’re gathering for sunset dinners, unwinding after a beach day, or enjoying quiet mornings with coffee on a balcony, every detail is designed to elevate your stay. Surrounded by the natural beauty of towering oaks, winding paths, and nearby dining and boutique spots, you’ll experience the perfect balance of privacy and proximity. From beach days to evening strolls under the coastal canopy, this Seagrove retreat delivers a refined yet relaxed atmosphere that keeps guests returning year after year.
